task.description:
Design tests for Epic 4 compensation and restore reconciliation.

Produce test specs and integration tests that cover:
- EXP-401 compensation handler/error-boundary behavior
- first-class compensation event recording and reverse-order execution
- EXP-402 restore reconciliation using EXP-103 instance_waits descriptors
- restored_orphan marking / surface behavior

Keep tests runnable against real PostgreSQL; no mocks/stubs. Use per-test UUIDs for isolation.

Target output under tests/specs/ and tests/integration/ as appropriate.
acceptance_criteria: MUST coverage for EXP-401 and EXP-402
Artifacts placed in tests/specs/ and tests/integration/

result.summary: Created EXP-401 and EXP-402 test specs plus PostgreSQL integration tests for compensation/error-boundary validation and restore reconciliation/orphan marking.

issues.description: EXP-401 runtime compensation execution/event-recording APIs are not present in current engine implementation; tests cover implemented definition-validation behavior.
